source_analysis.skill: Evaluate exact tangent of a nonstandard angle by applying the supplied special-angle sum or difference and rationalizing.
reasoning_steps: Read the supplied angle decomposition and select the matching tangent addition/subtraction identity.
Substitute signed exact special-angle tangent values from the unit circle.
Clear fractions where needed, rationalize a two-term denominator with its conjugate, and simplify to the exact value.
Select the one mathematically matching option in a five-choice radio field.
invariants: Supplied decomposition uses finite defined special-angle tangents.
No symbolic unknown angles or new identities required.
The worked solution must show all algebra needed to match its fraction-free radical choice.
Source standalone questions use radio responses with five complete choices; canonical example has no recorded choice bank.
permitted_variations: Sum versus difference, special-angle operands, degree versus radian notation, and supported unit-circle quadrants.
Correct value, sign/magnitude interval, answer position and plausible same-method error choices may vary.
Do not fix source examples' angle or key position merely because it occurred in the source.
